items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 183:1
items.html: There are only three vessels in the Partzuf, KHB, in which NRN clothe, and they are called the internal NRN. And there is the aspect of Ruach and Nefesh that clothe in the vessels of ZON, which are the flesh and the skin, called the external vessels, and they are called the external Nefesh and Ruach. See above, answer 182. (Part 1, Page 986, Sub Header, "from here").
